# SOP-01: Purchase orders into the order sheet

## Purpose

This procedure is how item 1 of the new process is done. [map/future.md item 1]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| order coordinator | checks that new orders reached the order sheet |
| operations manager | answers questions about an order that did not arrive |

## When

Every working day; the import checks the orders mailbox every 15 minutes from 07:00 to 19:00. [docs/run-log.md]

## Steps

1. Customers send purchase orders as PDFs to the orders mailbox; nothing is forwarded by hand. [map/future.md item 1]
2. A few times a day, the order coordinator checks the new orders are in the order sheet (software step: see the Order coordinator guide, "Check that new orders reached the order sheet"). [SC-01]

## Exceptions and who handles them

An email with no readable purchase order goes to the exceptions list; the order coordinator asks the customer for a PDF. [SC-02]

## Escalation

The operations manager, then the owner for an order over the spending limit. [map/roles.md owner]

## Records kept

The order emails stay in the orders mailbox. The client has not said how long these are kept; ask before setting a period.

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2027-02-03]
